notes.title: Press F12 🔑 to submit FEEDBACK 🔥 or BUGS 🐛
notes.content:
[url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Fn_sgcPWIAYRD3B?format=jpg&name=large][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Fn_sgcPWIAYRD3B?format=jpg&name=large[/img][/url]
HINT: Type the word "gold" on the Character Select screen for free gold 💰

[b]FEATURES COMING SOON:[/b]
[olist]
[*] 4 additional difficulties (8 total)
[*] 4 additional Wildwords (ice comet, poison dot, critical hits, and mesmerize)
[*] Unlock Map: Wilds by default but lock the other maps until completed in order (Wilds -> Tundra -> Abyss -> Crypt)
[*] Add lots of sound effects and music for different maps and success/death screens
[*] Swapping out 3 of the dragons for 3 different dragons so all 4 dragons are unique
[*] I'm open to changing the characters on the character select screen to something else if there is enough interest
[*] Balancing the scoring/gold/difficulty for damage/hp and timing is also an ongoing improvement process[/olist]
Pretty much the whole game is in a stage where you can truly make a real difference if you tell me what you don't like about it.  I want to make it AMAZING and frictionless for the end user, (who is most likely going to be a younger person learning how to type or an experienced typer wanting to test their skills)  We need to cater to all age groups and skills!
